null_design.baseline: per-arm linear model of each contrast in log n, fitted on that arm's own quiet intervals (gate1g's quiet_pairs rule) with the pre-maturity warm-up excluded; quiet intervals scored leave-one-out.
null_design.floors: sigma_quiet (the z unit), the arm's empirical quiet max|z| and p90|z|, and two event-matched rotation-blind arms.
caveats: quiet intervals admit absorption tails, so event excesses are lower bounds and quiet floors are upper bounds
a checkpoint delta is ||sum_t g_t||, not sum_t ||g_t||
banked lags: rotation 125; burst 25 and 125; drift 125 (wave 1) and 25 (wave 2)
